content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Project Associate – I at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Technology Calicut (Office of Research and Consultancy)
AI-enabled urban structural safety assessment and resilience framework for public buildings
Centre of Excellence in Urban Planning and Design (CoEUPD) – NIT Calicut
1 year (on contract basis), extendable for 1 more year

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Technology Calicut is an engineering institute in Calicut, and this position is advertised by its Office of Research and Consultancy. The Project Associate – I will work on the CoEUPD research project in the Department of Civil Engineering, titled "AI-enabled urban structural safety assessment and resilience framework for public buildings". The sponsoring agency named in the notice is the Centre of Excellence in Urban Planning and Design (CoEUPD) – NIT Calicut.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering with minimum 60% marks (or 6.0 CGPA) OR M.E./M.Tech/MS in Civil Engineering specialisation with minimum 60% marks (or 6.0 CGPA) from a recognised university/institute. Desirable: GATE qualification Prior experience in projects related to Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Age limit: The notice gives the age limit as 35 years. It does not print a date on which age is counted or any age relaxation. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Associate – I gets a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 30,000, with 20 % HRA on top of it. The engagement is for 1 year on contract basis and is extendable for 1 more year based on the performance of the candidate and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Project Associate – I
content_sections.text: Fill the registration form annexed to the notice. Prepare your most recent CV and soft copies of the mark sheets/certificates supporting your academic qualification and experience. Consolidate all the soft copies into a single PDF document (the notice says they "may" be consolidated). Email the filled form and documents to [email protected] , with a copy to [email protected] . Use the subject line "Application for Project Associate-I –CoEUPD/CED/RK-517". Send the application by 10 December 2026, the last date for application submission. Documents named in the notice: Duly filled registration form (as annexed) Most recent CV Soft copies of mark sheets/certificates in support of academic qualification/experience No Objection Certificate from the employer, at the time of interview, for applicants already in employment (government or any other organisation)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be shortlisted, and the eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for the interview. The interview is an offline interview scheduled for 14 December 2026. The notice does not print the interview venue or reporting time; shortlisted candidates are informed by email.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of the information, other documents and photograph submitted. Applicants already in employment (government or any other organisation) must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of interview along with the other documents. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
